description: This file contains scripts for creating and managing quizzes within the FreeCodeCamp curriculum, including functions for generating quiz files, updating JSON configurations, and prompting user input.

methods.name: createQuiz
methods.description: Main function to create a quiz, update intro JSON, create challenge and metadata JSON, and update superblock structure.

methods.name: updateIntroJson
methods.description: Updates the intro.json file with the new quiz title.

methods.name: createMetaJson
methods.description: Creates and writes the metadata JSON for the quiz block.

methods.name: createQuizChallenge
methods.description: Generates the quiz challenge file and returns its ObjectId.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file into a specified schema.

methods.name: withTrace
methods.description: Wraps an async function to add error stack trace information.
